There came a reeling feeling that dripped down from the ceiling, intensely unappealing after years of self-concealing.
lines.zh: 一种天旋地转的感觉自天花板滴落而下，在多年的自我隐藏之后，显得格外令人不适。

lines.en: A piece of you inside a box, a puzzle the whole world won’t (stop) to tear off all the wrapping, sink their hands inside thus trapping, handicapping realization when you can’t become a whole.
lines.zh: 你的一块碎片装在盒子里，一整个世界都不会（停下来）去撕掉所有包装、把手探进去的谜题——从而在你无法变得完整时，困住、也残废掉那份领悟。

lines.en: Just a hole for those who don’t. A mole for those who do. A prole if your name’s Orwell and you’ve given up on being you.

lines.en: Between the bodies and the people you see, laced in every passing glance bequeathed unto thee, you might notice that you’re dizzy.
